brief: public static WriteOutContentHandler newInstance(ContentHandler handler, ParseContext context){}
method_comment:
* Creates a new WriteOutContentHandler configured from OutputLimits in the ParseContext. *

* If OutputLimits is present in the context, the handler will be configured with those * limits (writeLimit, throwOnWriteLimit). Otherwise, default values are used (-1 for * unlimited, true for throwOnWriteLimitReached). * * @param handler the content handler to decorate * @param context the ParseContext (may be null) * @return a configured WriteOutContentHandler
